skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop proficiency in all four English language skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) for academic and professional contexts related to Management Information Systems.
Expand vocabulary specific to Management Information Systems.
Understand and communicate about Information Systems, their components, and their role in business strategy and organization.
Understand and communicate about databases and information management in business contexts.
Understand and communicate about telecommunications, the Internet, and wireless technology.
Understand and communicate about information security and system vulnerabilities.
Understand and communicate about global e-business and collaboration technologies.
Understand and communicate about IT infrastructure and emerging technologies.
Develop skills in presenting and discussing topics related to Management Information Systems in English.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and discuss topics related to Management Information Systems.
